name: codex-bridge
description: Chat with OpenAI Codex CLI inside Claude Code: Codex answers in the same conversation with native tool rows, diffs and questions, and you switch back to Claude anytime. Also asks OpenRouter models.

openrouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouterApiKey.description: Used by /or, the openrouter_ask tool and Codex over OpenRouter, and sent only to openrouter.ai. Leave empty if you don't use OpenRouter.

openrouterModel.title: Default OpenRouter model
openrouterModel.description: Model id used when /or names none, e.g. openrouter/auto or anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5.

codexProvider.title: Codex provider
codexProvider.description: Type codex to use Codex's own login and config, or openrouter to run Codex against OpenRouter with the key above. Anything else counts as codex.

codexModel.title: Codex model
codexModel.description: Model passed to codex -m. Blank uses ~/.codex/config.toml (or the OpenRouter default model when the provider is openrouter).

codexSandbox.title: Codex sandbox for /codex
codexSandbox.description: Type workspace-write to let Codex change files in the project folder (in Codex chat and /codex), or read-only to keep it from changing anything. Anything else counts as workspace-write. Claude's codex_run tool is read-only unless Claude asks otherwise.
